## Category

**Category file:** `categories/[FILENAME].md`

## What Needs to Be Done

Add a detailed comparison section below the main table that includes:

- [ ] Pros and cons for each service
- [ ] Best use cases (hobby project, startup, enterprise)
- [ ] Head-to-head comparison table (features side by side)
- [ ] "When to choose X over Y" guidance
- [ ] Any gotchas or hidden limits not in the main table

## Guidelines

- Research each service's official docs, not just the pricing page
- Include real-world experience notes where available
- Keep it factual — no marketing language
- Follow the formatting in other expanded categories
- Branch: `expand/[category-name]`
- PR title: `expand: [category] comparisons`

## Resources

- Check each service's official documentation
- Look for comparison blog posts for reference
- Test free tiers yourself if possible
